title: Controlled casting-like multi-fidelity discrepancy benchmark

design_space.candidate_id: candidate_id = i * grid_size + j; x=i/(grid_size-1), y=j/(grid_size-1)

deterministic_heteroscedastic_perturbati.random_seed: None; the perturbations are deterministic functions of design and severity.

policies.description: 75 low-fidelity screens followed by five diverse weighted-sum promotions.
Fifty low screens, ten medium-fidelity evaluations and four fixed top-k promotions.
Low/medium paired discrepancy estimates, two high-fidelity anchors and three discrepancy-corrected promotions.

primary_diagnostics: High-fidelity observed hypervolume divided by true finite-pool hypervolume.
High-fidelity hypervolume against total fidelity cost.
Constraint false-promotion count/rate based on pre-promotion predicted margin.
Per-fidelity call counts and cost units.
Low-to-high scalar-rank inversions and feasibility inversions.
safety_and_validity_limits: High-fidelity truth is available only to the benchmark audit path after the policy returns; this is API separation, not a sandbox against malicious same-process Python introspection.
This is a controlled finite-pool synthetic function, not a thermodynamic model, CFD solver or foundry process.
The chosen formulas and cost units are stress-test conventions, not calibrated industrial cost ratios.
No policy is presumed superior. Report all seeds and ablations.
Later work must sweep severity, cost ratios, feasibility thresholds and noise; use paired seeds and confidence intervals.
No physical safety, product quality or SOTA claims can be derived from this fixture.
